v0.ref: pkg/authorization/authz.go (*Ctx).AuthZRequest forwards the body to the AuthZ plugin only when `sendBody(uri,hdr) && r.ContentLength > 0 && r.ContentLength < maxBodySize` — a chunked / Content-Length:0 body (ContentLength<=0) is NEVER shown to the plugin (CVE-2024-41110 / 2019 regression).

v1.ref: CVE-2024-41110 fix (commit fc274cd2ff4cf3b48c91697fb327dd1fb95588fb) added `|| isChunked(r)` so a chunked body IS shown to the plugin; but AuthZRequest STILL gates on `r.ContentLength < maxBodySize` (maxBodySize=1048576) and drainBody's `Peek(maxBodySize)` returns a NIL body ('skipping body') for oversized payloads => a body >= 1 MiB is never shown to the plugin while the daemon acts on it (CVE-2026-34040 residual).

v2.ref: CVE-2026-34040 fix (commit e89edb19ad7de0407a5d31e3111cb01aa10b5a38) drops the size condition; AuthZRequest wraps the body in bufio.NewReaderSize(r.Body, maxBodySize+1) and `Peek(maxBodySize+1)` — on success (body too large) it FAIL-CLOSED rejects the request ('request body too large for authorization plugin: size exceeds %d bytes') instead of forwarding an empty body.
